description: This file defines interfaces for system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime management, and metadata within the WPEFramework's Controller namespace. It contains pure virtual classes with methods for rebooting, deleting, cloning, environment querying, starting discovery, configuration persistence, plugin lifecycle management, and retrieving system metadata.

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations such as reboot, delete, clone, and environment variable retrieval.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery operations, including starting discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration persistence and retrieval for specific callsigns.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for managing plugin lifecycle states and notifications, including activation, deactivation, suspension, and Hibernate.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for retrieving system metadata such as proxies, status, links, process info, subsystems, version, and call stacks.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Provides the value of a request environment variable.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores the configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration
methods.description: Retrieves or sets configuration values for a callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for lifetime events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink for lifetime events.

methods.name: Unavailable
methods.description: Sets a plugin as unavailable for interaction.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Sets a plugin in Hibernate state with a timeout.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides status of a plugin, including configurations.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides callstack information for a given index.
